subject.title: Feature Request: Gateway lifecycle hooks (onSubagentComplete, onToolCallThreshold, onTurnComplete)

question: Should OpenClaw expose subagent completion, agent turn completion, and tool-call threshold data through workspace/internal hooks, and what boundary should separate safe observation from typed plugin control?
rationale: The source gap is proven, but the requested surface affects public hook API shape, sensitive session/subagent/tool state exposure, mid-turn behavior, and overlapping plugin hook contracts that automation should not decide.

options.title: Observation-Only Workspace Events
options.body: Add narrow workspace/internal lifecycle events with minimized metadata while keeping mutation, mid-turn control, and sensitive tool/session access in typed plugin hooks.

options.title: Keep Lifecycle Control Plugin-Only
options.body: Treat typed plugin hooks and related open PRs as the supported lifecycle surface and decline broader HOOK.md workspace expansion for this data.

options.title: Design One Lifecycle Contract First
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define one lifecycle model covering internal hooks, typed plugin hooks, payloads, thresholds, permissions, and ordering.

recommendation.title: Observation-Only Workspace Events
recommendation.body: Add narrow workspace/internal lifecycle events with minimized metadata while keeping mutation, mid-turn control, and sensitive tool/session access in typed plugin hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision extends the hook contract and subagent completion surfaces where vincentkoc has the strongest recent current-main history.
